messages:
people-ops-bot: Heads-up — Maria's birthday is Tue Sep 9. Quick poll: React with :one:, :two:, or :three: 1) Mobile coffee cart in the kitchen at 10:30am 2) Ship cozy care packages to remote folks 3) Virtual hangout + e-card. Reply with notes/allergies. RSVP by Mon 5pm.
harriet (People Ops): We can do a combo (cart + packages) if people want both. Need headcount for GF/vegan and any mailing addresses. Volunteers for setup appreciated.
maria: you are all so sweet! Coffee cart sounds fun but i'm low-key. no big fuss. :)
ben: :one: coffee cart please. i'll bring my fancy espresso beans for the cart if that helps.
aya: :two: remote here, so care package would be lovely. also i'm allergic to soy, please avoid soy snacks.
noah: :three: virtual hangout works for PST folks. can we do a 20-min chill break with a short trivia?
harriet (People Ops): noted soy allergy and preference for a low-key approach. Signup: https://forms.gle/maria-bday-options — pick 1/2/3, dietary notes, and shipping address if remote. Closing Mon 5pm.
ben: volunteers — i'll handle coordination with the cart vendor and bring spare reusable cups.
maria: please no balloons (latex allergy). also appreciate no candles.
aya: DM'ing my mailing address now.
people-ops-bot: Event placeholder created: "Maria birthday treats" — Calendar invite will be sent if in-office or virtual option wins.
harriet (People Ops): tiny logistical note — if we ship care packages, they'll be snack-focused and low-sugar on request. If cart wins, we'll keep it compostable-friendly (no single-use plastic). Final reminder: please fill the form by Mon 5pm.
noah: i'll help run the 10-min trivia if we do the virtual hangout.
ben: noted no balloons, and i'll avoid nut-based pastries to be safe.
maria: thank you all <3 small handwritten card would make my day.
harriet (People Ops): will collect short messages for the card after poll closes. please keep replies short to avoid channel spam.
